import type { PluginOptions } from 'claude-code'

import { SOUNDS } from './notify'
import type { Durations } from './timer'

export type BreakPrompts = 'allow' | 'warn' | 'block'

export type Config = {
  defaults: Durations
  breakPrompts: BreakPrompts
  bypassPrefix: string
  notify: boolean
  focusEndSound: string
  breakEndSound: string
  autoBreak: boolean
}

const minutes = (v: unknown, fallback: number, max: number) => {
  const n = Number(v)
  return Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= max ? n : fallback
}

const sound = (v: unknown, fallback: string) =>
  v === 'none' || (SOUNDS as readonly unknown[]).includes(v) ? (v as string) : fallback

export function readConfig(o: PluginOptions): Config {
  const mode = o.breakPrompts
  const prefix = typeof o.bypassPrefix === 'string' ? o.bypassPrefix.trim() : ''
  return {
    defaults: { focusMin: minutes(o.focusMinutes, 25, 180), breakMin: minutes(o.breakMinutes, 5, 60) },
    breakPrompts: mode === 'allow' || mode === 'block' ? mode : 'warn',
    bypassPrefix: prefix || '>>',
    notify: o.notify !== false && o.notify !== 'false',
    focusEndSound: sound(o.focusEndSound, 'Glass'),
    breakEndSound: sound(o.breakEndSound, 'Hero'),
    autoBreak: o.autoBreak === true || o.autoBreak === 'true',
  }
}
